name: Phantasmal Killer

source.note: Entered for the Night Hag's spellcasting; check against the book.

summary: Wis save or 4d10 Psychic and Disadvantage on checks and attacks; 4d10 again on each failed save at the end of its turns (half on the first success).
text: You reach into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls for the duration; on a success it takes half as much damage and the spell ends. A target that failed repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking 4d10 Psychic damage on a failure and ending the spell on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
